title: Use serviceable capacity in the cost denominator
method: Synthetic annual cost 800,000; installed 500 units gives 1,600/unit; usable 500−100=400 gives 2,000/unit. Reserve is counted once; workload equivalence remains required.
alt: Use serviceable capacity in the cost denominator: Installed denominator 1600 currency units/year/unit, Usable denominator 2000 currency units/year/unit. Illustrative inputs.
